overview: This paper establishes a scaling law for deep learning loss and optimal learning rate based on convex optimization bounds, validating that loss scales asymptotically as O(1/sqrt(T)) and optimal peak learning rate scales as O(1/sqrt(T)) across various models and optimizers through data-driven regression and sequence-to-sequence prediction.

modules.name: Theoretical Bound & Qualifying Exam Evaluator
modules.description: Computes the theoretical upper bounds for SGD loss under different schedules (Constant, Inv-Sqrt, Linear, Cosine, WSD) and evaluates the 'Qualifying Exam' integral condition for a given schedule to determine if it achieves asymptotically optimal convergence.

modules.name: Horizon-Aware Learning Rate Scheduler
modules.description: Generates discrete learning rate sequences for qualified and non-qualified schedules, ensuring the peak learning rate scales appropriately with the training horizon (T) to support the scaling law analysis.

modules.name: Deep Learning Optimizer Suite
modules.description: Implements the optimizer algorithms required for the study, specifically including standard SGD, AdamW, and the specialized Muon-NSGD, to verify that the convex-like scaling behaviors generalize beyond standard SGD.

modules.name: Sequence-to-Sequence Loss Predictor
modules.description: Implements Generalization 1 by fitting the observed loss trajectory against the learning rate sequence via non-negative linear regression to estimate effective parameters and predict subsequent loss values during training.

modules.name: Scaling Law Regression Analyzer
modules.description: Implements Generalization 4 by performing linear regression of the final-iterate loss against the inverse square root of the training horizon for various reference learning rates, enabling the identification of the optimal reference learning rate and the irreducible loss.

modules.name: Multi-Architecture Training Pipeline
modules.description: Executes the model training loop for various architectures and modalities, logging the precise loss at specific iterations and managing checkpointing for subsequent scaling analysis.

modules.name: External Benchmark Data Processor
modules.description: Parses and normalizes experimental data from external scaling law studies to validate the proposed scaling law on pre-existing large-scale training results.

modules.name: Parameter-Efficient Training Adapter
modules.description: Integrates parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods into the training pipeline to test whether the convex-like scaling laws hold when only a subset of parameters are updated.

modules.name: Ablation & Robustness Driver
modules.description: Manages controlled experiments that vary critical hyperparameters and random seeds to assess the robustness of the convergence pattern across different training regimes.

modules.name: Result Visualization & Diagnostic Plotter
modules.description: Generates the specific diagnostic figures required by the paper, such as loss versus 1/sqrt(T) linearity plots, loss versus learning rate U-curves, and sequence-to-sequence prediction fits, along with computing fit quality scores.
